name: Adobe Firefly AI Assistant
desc: Conversational creative agent across Firefly and Creative Cloud apps
desc_zh: Firefly 和 Creative Cloud 里的对话式创意助手
solves: Finding the right tool for an edit took menu-hunting; describe the change and the assistant plans the steps in Adobe's apps.
solves_zh: 想做一个效果却不知道该用哪个工具；说出要改什么，助手会在 Adobe 应用里排好步骤。
best_for: You know the look you want in Premiere but not which panel to open; ask AI Assistant to get there.
best_for_zh: 知道 Premiere 里想要的效果，却不知道该开哪个面板；直接问 AI Assistant。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：C+D — TechCrunch Adobe tag feed, then the Adobe Blog index）。 Outside the window. Adobe published a post on 2026-04-27 ("Firefly AI Assistant now available in public beta") stating the beta went live that day, so the release date is confirmed by a first-party page dated the same day. Evolved from Project Moonlight (previewed at Adobe MAX 2025, private beta). On 2026-06-18 Adobe brought the assistant to Premiere, Photoshop, Illustrator, Frame.io and InDesign as "AI Assistant" (private beta in After Effects). The homepage is the Firefly product page; a dedicated assistant URL was not found. curl gets 403 from Adobe's bot guard on www.adobe.com/products/firefly.html; no other official assistant page was found, so the Firefly product page stands as the entry point. 首次公开日期来源：https://blog.adobe.com/en/publish/2026/04/27/firefly-ai-assistant-public-beta 官网未直接确认（403）。
